sections.heading: 1. Who We Are
body: This website is operated by Garvit Buildtech, a real estate developer based in Haridwar, Uttarakhand, India. For any privacy-related request, write to info@garvitbuildtech.com or call +91 82877 42699.

sections.heading: 2. What Personal Data We Collect
body: When you submit an enquiry form on this website, we collect:
• Your full name
• Your phone number
• Your email address (optional)
• The subject of your enquiry (e.g. a specific project)
• Technical metadata including your approximate IP address region and the page you submitted the form from.
We do not collect payment information, government identification, or sensitive personal data.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Data
body: We use the data you submit solely to respond to your real estate enquiry, schedule site visits, or deliver requested documents such as brochures.
We do not use your data for automated profiling, algorithmic decision-making, or targeted advertising.

sections.heading: 4. Who Sees Your Data
body: Your enquiry is delivered by email to the Garvit Buildtech sales team. It is not shared with third parties, sold, or used for any purpose beyond responding to your enquiry.
Email delivery is handled by our email service provider (Hostinger). No third-party CRM or marketing platform currently processes your personal data.

sections.heading: 5. How Long We Keep Your Data
body: Enquiry emails are retained for up to 24 months after our last interaction with you, after which they are permanently deleted, unless a longer period is required by law or an ongoing business relationship.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights Under the DPDP Act 2023
body: Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, you have the right to:
• Access personal data we hold about you
• Correct inaccurate personal data
• Request erasure of your personal data
• Withdraw consent at any time
• Nominate another person to exercise these rights on your behalf
To exercise any of these rights, contact us at info@garvitbuildtech.com.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies and Analytics
body: This website does not currently set analytics or advertising cookies. If we introduce analytics tools such as Google Analytics in future, they will load only after you give consent via the on-site consent banner, and this section will be updated accordingly.

sections.heading: 8. Security
body: All data is transmitted over HTTPS. Enquiries are delivered by encrypted SMTP email. We do not store enquiry data in a website database.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the Last Updated date at the top of this page. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
body: For privacy questions or requests, email info@garvitbuildtech.com or write to Garvit Buildtech, Palm City, IP-2 SIDCUL, near Denso Chowk, Haridwar, Uttarakhand, India.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
body: By accessing and using this website, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use this website.

sections.heading: 2. Website Purpose
body: This website is operated by Garvit Buildtech for informational purposes relating to real estate projects in Haridwar, Uttarakhand, India. It is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any property.

Where a project is registered under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, its RERA registration details will be stated on the relevant project page or in official project documentation.

sections.heading: 3. Accuracy of Information
body: While we make every effort to ensure that the information on this website is accurate and up to date, it is provided for general informational purposes only.

Project specifications, prices, availability, and timelines are subject to change without notice. Images and visuals on this website are representative in nature and may not depict the actual project. Prospective buyers must verify all details independently before making any decision.

sections.heading: 4. No Offer or Contract
body: Nothing on this website constitutes a legally binding offer, agreement, or contract for the sale of any property. Any transaction will be governed solely by the registered sale agreement and applicable law.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual Property
body: All content on this website — including text, images, architectural renderings, branding, and design — is the property of Garvit Buildtech or its licensors and is protected by applicable copyright and intellectual property laws.
You may not reproduce, distribute, or use any content without the express written permission of Garvit Buildtech.

sections.heading: 6. Third-Party Links and Maps
body: This website may contain links to third-party websites (including Google Maps). We are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or privacy practices of those sites.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
body: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Garvit Buildtech shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages arising out of your access to or use of this website or reliance on its content.

sections.heading: 8. Governing Law
body: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Haridwar, Uttarakhand.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to Terms
body: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective upon posting to this page with an updated date. Continued use of the website constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
body: For questions about these terms, email info@garvitbuildtech.com or write to Garvit Buildtech, Palm City, IP-2 SIDCUL, near Denso Chowk, Haridwar, Uttarakhand, India.
